```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(scipen=999)
```

This script plots the number of Ensembl Regulatory Features identified with the Ensembl Regulatory Build
and released in the 2026-08 version.


```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
```

The first step is to load the summarised data describing the number of feature 
per feature type for each species. 

The file containing this data is available in the [data](data) folder.

```{r}
data_folder <- "data"
read.delim(paste(data_folder, 'rfs_summary.2026-08.tsv', sep = '/'), 
           header = T, sep = '\t') -> rfs_summary
rfs_summary %>% 
  head()
```

Parsing the species names for a better display. 

```{r}
speciesMap <- c('Human', 'Mouse', 'Pig', 'Cattle', 'Chicken', 'Atlantic\nsalmon',
                'Rainbow\ntrout', 'Common\ncarp', 'European\nseabass', 'Turbot')
names(speciesMap) <- c('Human', 'Mouse', 'Pig', 'Cattle', 'Chicken', 
                      'Atlantic salmon', 'Rainbow trout', 'Common carp',
                      'European seabass', 'Turbot')
rfs_summary %>% 
  mutate(species_name = factor(speciesMap[species_name],
                               levels = speciesMap)) -> rfs_summary
```

Parsing the feature type for a better display. 

```{r}
feature_types <- c("promoter",  "enhancer", "open chromatin", 
                   "CTCF binding site")

rfs_summary %>%
  mutate(type = factor( type, levels = feature_types)) -> rfs_summary

```

```{r, fig.height=5, fig.width=9, dpi = 300}
rf_colors <- c('promoter' = '#d90000', 'enhancer' = '#f8c041', 
            'open chromatin' = '#b7c0c8', 'CTCF binding site' = '#8ef4f8')

rfs_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes (x = species_name, y = n, fill = type)) + 
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', position = position_stack(reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.9,0.9), 
        legend.background = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 0.5),
        panel.grid = element_blank()) + 
  labs(fill = '', x = '', y = 'Number of annotated regulatory regions') + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = rf_colors) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 650000), breaks = seq(0, 650000, 50000),
                     expand = c(0,0)) -> Figure_1_b
Figure_1_b

```
